context: Goro-grandpa and Sho-young visit the local fire station for a kids' tour.
purpose: Elder taking child on community education outing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、消防車、かっこいい!
lines.en: Grandpa, fire trucks are so cool!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. High energy but not shouty. Wonder in the voice—genuine delight, not performed. Eager lean into the words.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: Firefighters have real courage, don't they.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. A gentle observation shared more than stated. Warm fondness underneath. Slow, unbothered pace. Almost thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small voice, genuine question. Seeking confirmation, not showing off. Soft and attentive—listening as much as asking. Slight lift at the end, genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん、毎日、訓練してるんや。
lines.en: Yeah, they train every single day.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact. The tone of someone sharing a simple fact with real care. Unhurried. Slight warmth on 'every day'—acknowledgment of the boy's wonder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to protect people too.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A sincere declaration without performance. Steady, earnest breath. Small but certain. The voice of a child understanding something true about himself.
